name: labs/baroobob__keithley2400
title: Keithley 2400 source-measure unit
intro: Keithley 2400 source-measure unit, adapted from baroobob/keithley2400. It reads `trigger_delay`; sets `voltage` and `output`; runs `measure_current`, `measure_voltage`, `measure_resistance` and `safe_state`. `measure_current`: configure current measurement (CONF:CURR, FORM:ELEM CURR) in source-voltage mode and read one sample with the trigger settings of the clone; the source voltage is not changed. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
